Fact: data_scope
What to find: Scope and main characteristics of the training data (domains, languages, geography, modality coverage).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Trained on publicly available third-party datasets (referenced in the technical report and the Molmo2 data collection), which contain highly-curated image-text and video-text pairs; the model supports image, video and multi-image understanding and grounding. The card notes the third-party datasets are subject to academic and non-commercial research use only. Languages and geography are not stated beyond the metadata language tag "en".
quotes:
Molmo2 models are trained on publicly available third party datasets as referenced in [our technical report](https://allenai.org/papers/molmo2) and [Molmo2 data](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data), 
a collection of datasets with highly-curated image-text and video-text pairs.
Molmo2 is a family of open vision-language models developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that support image, video and multi-image understanding and grounding.
This model is trained on third party datasets that are subject to academic and non-commercial research use only.
